prose.text: The block runs, in order: - the formatter and the linter; - the rig's library unit cases with `--no-fail-fast`, then the workspace unit layer (the entry the `cx-relook`   control was measured on); - the rig rehearsals by name (`rig_rehearsal` is an integration binary); - the live round: the install read, a census, the build, `R4-2`'s kept-dir absence, `R4-2`, a census, `R4M`'s   kept-dir absence, `R4M`, a census, `L2`, then the operator-keyed census; - after the landing, the checks over the landed set: the set against the recorders' output, the resume variant,   `cli_verify`, the `contract_*` and `mcp_*` binaries, and the whole integration and E2E layers; - the operator pass.

What is not run, and why: - No smoke entry: no boot-path file changes. The harness boot stamps at the default 2.1.287, which this chunk does not   move. - No release check: `viola-e2e` is test-only and refused by `scripts/release-check.sh`, and the product graph is   unchanged. - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 8). - Entries 1–5 are not re-fired at this revision's re-entry (§R).

Bounds and homes: - The rehearsal waits through the file's existing helpers, under the integration profile's kill. The unit cases do not   wait. - The rig's `--deadline` bounds each live start under its entry's `timeout`. - Every rehearsal runs under its case's own dirs. The live starts run under the rig's private scratch at   `/tmp/viola-rig-<uid>/`, which names no `home` component.

The live legs' non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of them: the install read by path, the rig's census, the build with its hashes, and each start's kept-dir absence read. None primes anything.

**The remove-the-guard control** is implement's one-shot `gate.py control`, not an entry (validation.md check 4 (6)). It was fired and read «holds» in the stopped run (§R); it is not re-fired. - **Id and file:** `cx-relook`, in `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/mod.rs`. - **The edit:** removes the second `session_transcript` lookup in `transcript_after_send`'s none-held arm. That is   the one line step 1 writes there; implement quotes its exact text in the control record. - **Case:** `rig::tests::transcript_after_send_reads_one_written_after_the_send_from_its_start`, named as nextest   prints the NAME. - **Firing:** on entry 4 (`bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --unit`, the workspace unit layer) with `--timeout 2400`.   This is the entry it was truly measured on (`inputs#I6` item 7). A package-scoped entry (entry 3) builds no   `viola-fake-agent` in a fresh clone, so four harness cases fail there on ENOENT and the control reads UNREPRODUCED   (`evidence/control-1.txt`). - **Reading:** «holds» only when that case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line. A `timeout` reading is not «holds»,   and neither is an entry that is merely red.
